prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one complete explanatory illustration for a university slide titled "La UI è parte della UX".
Primary request: make containment unmistakable: User Interface is one part INSIDE the wider User Experience, which also includes human needs, expectations, context and the quality of the actual service.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its precise editorial 2D contour language, simplified human figures, matte fills and pale green palette. Do not reuse its table, research conversation or composition.
Composition: wide landscape about 2.3:1. A large pale green softly rounded functional UX boundary encloses the entire diagram. This boundary is essential to the concept, not an outer decorative picture frame. At the top of this region place the UX heading and sentence. In the lower LEFT portion, a visibly smaller white UI region is FULLY CONTAINED in UX, with its own heading, sentence and a compact smartphone booking interface illustration. In the lower RIGHT portion, INSIDE UX but OUTSIDE UI, show a small physical home-service scene: a physiotherapist meeting a seated client and guiding a gentle arm movement. The encounter is ordinary and non-medical-looking, with no equipment or treatment claims. A small thought/calendar detail can refer to needs and expectations. Leave clear space around all text; no illustrations behind lettering. Containment rather than a sequential process is the message. Do not put UI and UX side by side as equal concepts, do not use intersecting Venn circles and do not draw arrows implying UX happens only after UI.
Text, EXACT and ONLY these four lines of content, with sentence wrapping allowed:
"User Experience"
"Bisogni, aspettative, contesto, uso e qualità del servizio."
"User Interface"
"Elementi e comportamenti che rendono possibile l’interazione."
Typography: crisp large modern sans-serif resembling Inter. Bold headings. Regular sentences, readable at 1000 px overall display width. The UI sentence can occupy two or three lines. No other text, letters, numbers, logos, buttons with lettering or watermarks.
Palette: Tailwind lime-950 #192E03 fine outlines and main text, lime-800 #3C6300 structural emphasis, lime-100 #ECFCCA and green-100 #DCFCE7 pale fills, white UI area and papers, one tiny lime-300 #BBF451 selection. Natural pale skin tones as in the reference.
Background: real alpha transparency outside the functional UX region. Opaque matte fills inside it. Entire subject and all four texts fully visible with generous transparent margins. No cropping. No cast shadows, glow, gradients, texture, grain, 3D shading, decorative leaves or enclosing card outside the UX boundary. Calm precise educational illustration.
